get.summary: Get current user profile
get.description: Returns account profile fields for the authenticated user. Requires the `user:read` scope and the `read` entitlement.

delete.x-forge-require-confirmation: This starts deleting your account and all of its data. Bredbox emails you a confirmation link, and the deletion is permanent once confirmed.
delete.description: Requests an email confirmation before deleting the user's account and all associated data. Requires the `user:delete` scope. This action is permanent once confirmed.

409.description: Conflict - privacy request already in progress or awaiting confirmation

get.summary: Get current user interests
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's selected topic interest slugs. Requires the `user:read` scope and the `read` entitlement.

put.description: Replaces the authenticated user's selected topic interests. Input is normalized to lowercase and de-duplicated before persistence. Requires the `user:write` scope and the `write` entitlement.

get.summary: Get current user personalization setting
get.description: Returns whether Bredbox may generate personalized recommendations for the authenticated user. Requires the `user:read` scope and the `read` entitlement.

put.description: Turns personalized recommendations on or off for the authenticated user. Selected topics and hidden recommendations are retained either way. Requires the `user:write` scope and the `read` entitlement.

delete.x-forge-require-confirmation: This starts clearing all of your saved data. Bredbox emails you a confirmation link, and the data is permanently deleted once confirmed. Your account stays active.
delete.description: Requests an email confirmation before clearing all user saved data. The account remains active after confirmation.

409.description: Conflict - privacy request already in progress or awaiting confirmation

post.x-forge-require-confirmation: This confirms a pending deletion request. The data it covers is permanently deleted.
post.description: Confirms a pending privacy request using the raw email token, promotes the job to pending, and enqueues background processing.

403.description: Confirmation token belongs to a different user

409.description: Confirmation token can no longer be used

get.summary: Get background job status
get.description: Retrieves the current status of a background job initiated by the user (e.g., account deletion, data clearance).

get.summary: Get the current user's inbound email address
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's active inbound email capture address for a purpose, or 404 when none has been generated. Never creates one — use `POST` to generate. Requires the `user:write` scope and the `read` entitlement.

404.description: No address has been generated for this purpose

500.description: Unable to read the inbound email address

post.summary: Generate the current user's inbound email address
post.description: Generates an inbound email capture address for the authenticated user, or returns the existing one. Responds 201 when an address was created and 200 when one already existed. Requires the `user:write` scope and the `write` entitlement, so a read-only account is refused.

403.description: Missing scope or missing write entitlement

500.description: Unable to generate an inbound email address

patch.summary: Update the current user's inbound email address status
patch.description: Updates the status of the authenticated user's inbound email capture address between active and disabled. Requires the `user:write` scope and the `write` entitlement, so a read-only account is refused.

403.description: Missing scope or missing write entitlement

404.description: No address has been generated for this purpose

500.description: Unable to update the inbound email address

get.summary: List API tokens
List available API token scopes
get.description: Returns the canonical scope catalog for v2 endpoints, including separate `:write` and `:delete` scopes where applicable. There is no `/v2/webhooks/scopes` endpoint.

get.summary: Get an API token by ID

patch.summary: Update and regenerate an API token
patch.x-forge-require-confirmation: This regenerates the token, which invalidates the current one immediately. Anything using it stops working until it is given the new token.

delete.x-forge-require-confirmation: This revokes the token immediately. Anything using it can no longer call the API.

post.x-forge-require-confirmation: This invalidates the current token immediately. Anything using it stops working until it is given the new token.

get.summary: List available webhook event types
get.description: Returns the stable v1 webhook event catalog used for outbound deliveries. Requires `webhooks:read` scope and the `developer` entitlement.

200.description: List of supported webhook event types

get.summary: List webhooks
get.description: Returns a paginated list of webhooks owned by the authenticated user. Requires `webhooks:read` scope and the `developer` entitlement.

post.description: Creates a webhook for the authenticated user. Requires `webhooks:write` scope and the `developer` entitlement.

get.summary: Get a webhook by ID
get.description: Returns one webhook owned by the authenticated user, including the 10 most recent delivery attempts. Requires `webhooks:read` scope and the `developer` entitlement.

patch.description: Updates mutable webhook fields (including status for enable/disable). Requires `webhooks:write` scope and the `developer` entitlement.

delete.x-forge-require-confirmation: This deletes the webhook. Bredbox stops sending it events immediately.
delete.description: Deletes a webhook owned by the authenticated user.

get.summary: List connected applications

delete.x-forge-require-confirmation: This disconnects the application and revokes its access immediately. It must be authorized again to use your account.
